_comment: How model families control thinking (task 0361). Read from each model's chat template and card on Hugging Face (2026-11-25). The first entry whose `match` text occurs in the model id (case-insensitive) applies, so list specific families before general ones. `thinking`: none (never thinks), toggle (a chat-template switch turns it on or off), always (cannot be turned off). `switch`: the chat_template_kwargs name of the toggle. `levels`: the reasoning_effort value to send per effort; a missing level sends none. `tested`: where and how the entry was checked against a running server (see scripts/probe-thinking.py). `family`: true marks a fallback for a whole family whose switch is shared but whose levels are not verified; a level is then tried and dropped when the server refuses it.

tested: oMLX 0.8.3, Inkling-2-Mini-oQ4e-mtp (2026-11-25): every value accepted, unknown ones ignored; reasoning grows with effort (none about half of xhigh).
models.note: Effort none..max (default 0.9, about high); none does not fully disable reasoning.

tested: oMLX 0.8.3, Dirk-Qwen3.8-27B (2026-11-25): every value accepted, unknown ones ignored; enable_thinking=false or reasoning_effort=none turns thinking off.

SGLang on DGX Spark, qwen3.8-27b with its own template (lean default, high and max map to xhigh, minimal to low) (2026-11-25): unknown values return 400; enable_thinking=false or none turns thinking off.
models.note: The template accepts only low, medium and xhigh (default) and raises an error for others. Covers Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and fine-tunes such as ThinkingCap and Dirk.

tested: oMLX 0.8.3, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (2026-11-25): no thinking unless enable_thinking=true; reasoning_effort is ignored.
models.note: Thinking is off unless enable_thinking is set; no effort levels.
reasoning_effort low shortens thinking; other values think normally.
Interleaved thinking that cannot be turned off.
Non-think, Think High and Think Max modes; Max needs a special system prompt and is not offered.
Reasoning cannot be turned off; low is the least.
Qwen3 and later share enable_thinking; levels differ by generation (Qwen3.8 takes only low, medium and xhigh).
